word_order: SVO — subjects precede verbs and objects follow (e.g., 'Buses depart the inter-district bus station')
punctuation_present: always — as observed in the sample
discourse_markers: at the other end (of the spectrum)
notes_for_prompt_writer: Split preferentially at strong punctuation (sentence-final . ? !) and at coordinating/subordinating conjunctions that begin independent clauses, but do not emit segments that leave a short preposition or subordinating word stranded (e.g., 'to', 'of', 'that', 'while'). Avoid splitting on periods that are part of abbreviations, dotted technical tokens, decimal numbers, or times. Always attach trailing punctuation characters listed above to the preceding segment.
